v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Angelis suis * Deus mandávit de te, ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
text.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee, * to keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Laudémus Dóminum, * quem laudant Angeli, quem Chérubim et Séraphim, sanctus, sanctus, sanctus proclámant.
text.en: Let us praise the Lord, * Whom the Angels do praise, unto Whom Cherubim and Seraphim do cry, Holy, Holy, Holy.

text.la: Angeli eórum * semper vident fáciem Patris mei, qui est in cælis.
text.en: In heaven their Angels do always behold the face of My Father, * Which is in heaven.

text.la: Benedíctus Deus, * qui misit Angelum suum, et éruit servos suos qui credidérunt in eum.
text.en: Blessed be God, * Who sent His Angel, and delivered His servants that trusted in Him.

text.la: Laudáte Deum, * omnes Angeli eius: laudáte eum, omnes Virtútes eius.
text.en: Praise ye God, * all His Angels Praise ye Him, all His hosts.

text.la: Ecce ego mittam Angelum meum, qui præcédat te, et custódiat in via, et introdúcat in locum, quem parávi. Obsérva eum et audi vocem eius.
text.en: Behold I will send my angel, who shall go before thee, and keep thee in thy journey, and bring thee into the place that I have prepared. Take notice of him, and hear his voice.

v.la: In conspéctu Angelórum psallam tibi, Deus meus.
v.en: Before the Angels will I sing praise unto thee, O my God.

r.la: Adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitébor nómini tuo.
r.en: I will worship toward thy holy Temple, and praise thy Name.

text.la: Revérsus est * Angelus qui loquebátur in me, et suscitávit me; quasi virum qui suscitátur a somno suo.
text.en: The Angel that talked * with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep.

text.la: Deus, qui ineffábili providéntia sanctos Angelos tuos ad nostram custódiam míttere dignáris: largíre supplícibus tuis; et eórum semper protectióne deféndi, et ætérna societáte gaudére.
text.en: O God, Who in thine unspeakable Providence hast been pleased to give thine holy Angels charge over us, to keep us, mercifully grant unto our prayers, that we be both ever fenced by their wardship here, and everlastingly blessed by their fellowship hereafter.
